architecture.editor: Existing Tiptap with SessionCredit provenance marks. No generated text insertion or editor replacement.
architecture.progress: Reads canonical activity typed_words; no second activity ledger or incremental credit counter. Existing activity API records sessions once. Daily and project goals unchanged.
architecture.persistence: LocalStorage stores versioned owner/document-scoped guidance plan and last goal. Existing IndexedDB/autosave persist document and canonical activity. Retry cache contains only SHA-256 fingerprint and UUID, no draft text.
architecture.ai: Existing /workspace/assistant, context resolver, provider, coaching policy, bounded validation retry, and AIRequest quota/idempotency transaction. No additional polling or typing-triggered AI.
architecture.subscription: Existing backend require_ai_user, expected owner, document ownership, explicit consent and project scope guards. session_direction uses suggestions; session_continue uses Writing Guidance. No quota/pricing changes.
architecture.database_changes: None. Existing Supabase project, RLS, activity and document persistence retained.

validation.backend: 95 selected tests passed: strict goals, goal-dependent scope, exact remaining allocations, malformed-output retry, context exclusion, quota category and Free/consent denial plus existing workspace/context/quota regressions.
validation.frontend: 4 shared foundation unit tests passed; TypeScript and production build passed; targeted oxlint passed.
validation.browser: Built real editor operated with isolated HTTP fixtures and real Tiptap/IndexedDB. Guided flow covers typing, original-content deletion, pasted text, undo/redo, pause/typing resume, early finish, refresh, next session, overshoot, AI failure fallback/retry recovery, Focus identity, empty draft, document switching, all intentions, goal recall, 320/390/768/1440px, dark mode, Spanish and reduced motion.
validation.regressions: Autosave navigation, AI-project/context, canonical session/completion/draft-recovery regressions passed. Session suite also ran WCAG checks.
validation.privacy: Synthetic test account/content only; no production customer data or paid model calls.
validation.production: Vercel READY with unoword.app alias on exact feature commit. Public /api/health/ready, Google auth, signed-out auth protection, editor/library/settings and unchanged extension download passed. Actual deployed editor with all API traffic intercepted passed panel/goal/consent checks; no unexpected mutations, hidden idle index reads or console errors.
validation.placement: Full guided session flow and accessibility rerun after moving the panel. Dedicated mobile check confirms Start writing closes the assistant, focuses the existing editor, and retains session progress when reopened. Deployed editor confirmed the card exists inside Writing Assistant only, with a clear document canvas and zero unexpected mutations or console errors.

limitations: Guidance plan/goal binding recovery is browser-local; canonical writing/activity use existing cross-device sync. A second device does not reconstruct the guided breakdown.
New interface is in the responsive web editor. Native application/extension standalone editors retain existing features; they do not receive duplicated guided-session controls in this release.
Provider request structures, coaching validation and dynamic scope verified with deterministic provider fixtures. Live paid-model personalization quality was not tested and is not claimed.
Manual sessions require the existing Pro web editor, but do not require consent or a successful AI request.
Clearing browser site data removes guidance plans, not cloud documents or historical statistics.
